evidence.detail: Exact-v308 rs/s/b/w extends R148 PluginPanel and owns a MaterialTabGroup-like rs/ui/components/b/e, CardLayout, content JPanel, EventBus, R488 PluginListPanel and nested panel/tab state.

The class creates material tabs backed by PluginPanel providers, switches the CardLayout by key, opens a plugin configuration by name, reacts to plugin selection and forwards J_/K_ lifecycle hooks to the active child panel.
R489 ConfigPlugin injects Provider<rs/s/b/w>, stores the resolved panel and uses it as the navigation panel for the Configuration toolbar button.
RuneLite TopLevelConfigPanel extends PluginPanel and has the same MaterialTabGroup + CardLayout composition, plugin-list/configuration routing and ConfigPlugin ownership.

candidates.note: Source-correlated exact-v308 recovery of RuneLite TopLevelConfigPanel.
